Done — `cargo test --test primary_test_2` passes (1 passed).

I added `format_invoice_statement` to `src/billing.rs:68`. It renders each invoice with `format_invoice` and appends one extra newline after each (since `format_invoice` already ends with `\n`, that produces the blank-line separator), then ends with `NEXT #<n>\n`.

The one subtle point: `<n>` is obtained by *peeking* at the sequence with `NEXT_INVOICE.load(SeqCst)` rather than `fetch_add`, so printing a statement never consumes an invoice number — the same class of bug commit `affa1c9` fixed for invoice previews. `recall` had no memories on the billing symbols, so I recorded this invariant in codegraph (anchored to `issue_number`) for future sessions.
